Procedure title: Invitation to tender for the Provision of a Digital PCR Platform, Associated Reagents and Support for Cancer Molecular Diagnostics Department within St James’s Hospital Dublin
Description: The Contracting Authority (CA) seeks to purchase one digital PCR instrument, including all hardware, software and ancillary equipment required for routine operation. The purchase shall include a minimum three-year comprehensive warranty, installation, commissioning and training.The CA intends initially to use the platform for assay development, evaluation and method transfer and wishes to purchase an agreed quantity/value of development reagents and consumables at the commencement of the contract. These reagents shall be available for draw-down by the laboratory as required over the three-year agreement. During the course of the agreement, the CA may elect to develop new assays or migrate selected existing molecular diagnostic assays to dPCR where this provides appropriate clinical, analytical or operational benefit. The extent and timing of such migration will be determined by the CA according to clinical and service requirements and does not represent a commitment to implement any specific assay or purchase any minimum quantity of reagents.

The Lunar Gateway is smaller than the ISS and will require less launches for its assembly. It is intended to be occupied by a crew of up to four astronauts for periods ranging from two weeks to two months, but otherwise operates as a robotic spacecraft.The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the contractor for Portable Equipment Panels (PEPs) in accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.The PEPs are part of the power subsystem that includes a set of batteries for energy storage and a set of power management, distribution and switch units that are responsible to control and regulate the battery charging and discharging in sun or during the eclipse phase; to control the balancing of all the battery cells during the charging phase; to connect each battery to the BCDR before the Launch or during the tests and disconnect it before the removal or during the test; to connect, disconnect and distribute the primary power to other elements of the Gateway when requested; to convert the primary power into secondary power to supply the various internal loads and heaters by switchable and protected power lines.From functional point of view the IHAB EPS is composed by two main power chains.
